issue: Vista Pacifico (Topolobampo, Sinaloa) appears CANCELLED. Sempra disclosed in its 2025 annual 10-K (filed 2026-02-26) that 'in December 2025, we agreed to terminate the existing development agreement' with CFE. Mexico's CNE had previously denied Sempra Infrastructure the permit to construct the liquefaction plant. The project never reached FID; Sempra provided no plan to reposition it under different ownership. GEM currently lists this terminal as 'proposed' (LastUpdated 2025-09-05). This is a proposed -> cancelled (or shelved) status change. Per sweep rules, status changes are flagged for the researcher to set in the live DB + timeline, not staged as a Status field edit (fetch_timeline endpoint is down). Two independent verified sources (LNG Prime, NaturalGasIntel) plus GEM wiki confirm.
suggested_action: Set Vista Pacifico status to cancelled (CancelledYear 2025/2026; development agreement terminated Dec 2025, disclosed Feb 2026). Add timeline entry. Note that the prior owner-set (Sempra, TotalEnergies, CFEnergia/CFE) all exited: Sempra-CFE development agreement terminated; TotalEnergies' MOU/16.6% stake lapses with the project. Sources: https://lngprime.com/lng-terminals/sempra-says-vista-pacifico-lng-partnership-terminated/179300/ ; https://naturalgasintel.com/news/sempra-axes-vista-pacifico-lng-plan-cutting-mexicos-proposed-export-capacity/

issue: GEM lists Capacity 0.05 with CapacityUnits 'MMcf/d' and CapacityinMtpa 0.00 for the Ursus-Aqualita LNG project at Coatzacoalcos II (PODEBI), Veracruz. The 0.05 MMcf/d figure looks like a data-entry error: trade press (Energy Magazine, MundoMaritimo, Feb 2025) describes 4 processing trains totaling ~47,000 mcf/d (~47 MMcf/d), a USD 1.8bn investment, with operational testing targeted late-2025/early-2026. 47 MMcf/d ~ 0.36 mtpa (at 1 MMcf/d ~ 0.0077 mtpa). Flagging rather than staging an edit because the published capacity figure/units are ambiguous (mcf/d vs MMcf/d) and need a primary CRE/CNE permit number to nail down baseload nameplate mtpa.
suggested_action: Confirm Coatzacoalcos II nameplate capacity against a primary CRE/CNE/ASEA permit or the Ursus-Aqualita filing. If the project is genuinely ~47 MMcf/d (~0.36 mtpa) the GEM CapacityinMtpa of 0.00 / Capacity 0.05 MMcf/d should be corrected. Source lead: https://energymagazine.mx/2025/02/ursus-aqualita-lng-anuncia-planta-de-gnl-en-coatzacoalcos/
